reasoning_content:
Everything works. Let me check a customer portal login as well, and verify the "installed.lock" prevents reinstall (install.pl says already installed). Also check temporary systemd units removed as per guide.

Let me check /etc/systemd/system for the install-complete units—they're absent (only qisutu-daemon.service present). Guide says they should be removed after completion. Good.

Let me verify the customer portal and the public form. Also verify the daemon's runtime context. Let me do a final check on the web installer stating already installed (confirmed). 

Let me check the security.key permissions per guide—owned by root:www-data. Fine.

One thing: guide says install.sh should produce var/log/install.log. Present.

Let me check the release.sha256 verification / version consistency, and check whether the app is actually at 2.0.2 (release.conf).

I think we have enough. Let me do a quick customer portal test and check public form.pl. Also confirm Apache serves static assets.
